[P2] Resolve the untested configuration-validation branch

CONTRIBUTING.md rule 4 requires a behavioral test for every new branch. The package tests only inspect handler source text, and the deployed template supplies `TELEMETRY_LOG_GROUP_NAME`, so neither verifies this initialization-failure path. Removing the guard would leave those assertions passing. Under rule 9, return to the design phase to decide whether this fixture needs missing-configuration handling; simplify away the unnecessary branch or retain it with a behavioral test that requires the rejection.
